notes.title: Warrior Architects Update - Version 1.0.7.5 (2025/7/27)
notes.content:
Update Details:

July 1

Fixed survival mode victory condition, now based on countdown timer

Updated hotkey UI interface

July 2

Modified text for certain mission objectives

July 15

Changed background music in the title scene

Fixed character portraits in the Avatar section

July 16

Adjusted UI elements that were partially obscured (unit panel, building panel, item panel)

July 21

Replaced title background image and added animation effects

Changed sound effect for arrow shooting

July 25

Ranged units now have a chance to retreat when enemies get too close

Fixed a bug where resources were not deducted correctly when units repaired buildings

notes.title: Warrior Architects updated to version 1.0.7.2 on June 2, 2025
notes.content:
Update contents:

Added [Ancient Style] buildings (can be researched between October and November)
Changed colors (lines and palettes) of many character and siege weapon sprites
Fixed a bug in the logic where units could not return resources to buildings
Added [Pirate] unit (can be researched between June and July)
Added pirate equipment to the [Equipment System] and fixed related logic and bugs
Added [Dragon] monster, which will appear in [Hard Survival Mode]
Fixed bugs in the save and research systems

notes.title: Warrior Architects updated to version 1.0.7.1 on May 11, 2025
notes.content:
Update Contents:

Modified grass and dirt sprite details

Fixed details of some building sprites

Corrected some sprite replacement issues

Adjusted survival mode rules (enemy levels now gradually increase over time)

[Barracks, Mill, Lumber Mill, Stone Quarry] no longer require research in the [Research Window]; these buildings are now available from the start

[Wooden Wall] maximum HP changed from 200 to 100

[Defense Tower] research requirement updated (stone requirement changed from 200 to 500; level 2 no longer requires player level)

Modified parts of the game UI

notes.title: Warrior Architects Update 1.0.6.2 (April 4, 2025)
notes.content:
Update Details:
Added more details to building sprites (added ceramic pots, baskets, door handles, etc.).
Fixed some sprite issues for grass and mountains.
Improved minimap logic:
Left-clicking on the top-right minimap will move the camera to the clicked coordinates.
When units are selected, right-clicking on the minimap will move the units to the corresponding location.

notes.title: Warrior Architects Update 1.0.6.1 (March 12, 2025 – March 26, 2025)
notes.content:
Update Details:

.Fixed synchronization errors in multiplayer mode.

.Fixed scripts that caused crashes in multiplayer mode.

.Fixed logic issues in unit production and abnormal game starts in multiplayer mode.

.Added the ability to customize the maximum number of players (2-16) when creating a server in multiplayer mode.

.Fixed an issue where dropped items could not be automatically picked up.

.Fixed some building sprites.

.Added an animation for trees growing from saplings to full-grown trees when regenerating.

notes.title: Warrior Architects will introduce a multiplayer mode in the full release
notes.content:
Warrior Architects will appear in the Spring Sale from March 13 to March 20!
This time, the game has received a major update, introducing the full multiplayer battle mode. In this mode, you can connect with nearby players for battles and create your own room, with up to 16 players per match.

The map features two tribes, one blue and one red. Players in the same tribe can work together to gather resources, construct buildings, train armies, and fight battles. The goal is to strengthen your tribe into a powerful empire and ensure its lasting prosperity.

Game Features
Story Mode: Embark on an adventure through 30 main storyline chapters, facing unique enemies and bosses.
Random Campaign Mode: Explore randomly generated battlefields, offering varied difficulties and endless strategic possibilities.
Creative Building Design: Plan and upgrade unique buildings to strengthen your power.
Real-Time Multiplayer Battles: Connect with nearby players to compete and expand your empire together.

Event Time
Pacific Time (PT): March 13, 2025 – March 20, 2025

You can try the demo version, and if you want to experience the multiplayer mode, the test version includes access to multiplayer mode testing!

Update to version 1.0.6 on March 12, 2025:

Fixed logic for selecting units.
Fixed logic and errors related to resource regeneration (trees, stone mines, gold mines, fruit trees).
Fixed errors in population requirements for unit production.

notes.title: Warrior Architects Updated to Version 1.0.3 on December 28, 2024
notes.content:
Update Details:

Fixed sprites for construction sites and some buildings.
Corrected three background music tracks.
Adjusted fog density in weather effects.
Added shadows to animals and buildings.
Mills, mines, and lumberyards in auto mode and hostile AI will now build near resources such as fruit trees, ore, and trees.
Game cursor will now hide when switching the mouse to a non-game window.
Fixed errors in the save system related to loading and regenerating gold mines, stone mines, fruit trees, and wood resources.

notes.title: Warrior Architects has been updated to version 1.0.2.2 on 2024/12/19.
notes.content:
Update content:

Fixed the sprite for grass and added more details to it.
Adjusted some settings for building sprites.
Added a new background music track.
Fixed the shadows of trees.
Fixed the shadow effects for units.
Corrected lightning effects for screen size issues.
Fixed the camera zooming issue.

notes.title: Warrior Architects Update 1.0.2 on December 10, 2024
notes.content:
Update Details:

Improved tree sprites, including redrawing leaf details and lighting effects.
Enhanced sprites for fruit trees, stone mines, and gold mines, focusing on detail and lighting.
Adjusted campaign generator default values (specifically related to unit skill parameters).
Fixed display errors for farmland names in the Japanese version.
Corrected certain building sprite settings.
Added new lighting effects to enhance visuals.
Improved details in mountain and snowy mountain sprites.
